# Consistency

A consistent product is predictable. Users learn one solution and apply it
everywhere. Inconsistency forces them to relearn for each surface.

## Practice

- Use the existing component library; do not roll your own
- Follow the canonical patterns in `docs/patterns/`
- Names, capitalization, spacing, and timing should match other surfaces
